It looks up at 45 degrees through the open bag mouth, a bright oval of overcast daylight from the open driver door. In sharp focus 10 cm from the lens, filling the centre of frame: one clean, thin, white panty liner in a long flat pale-pink unbranded wrapper, tilted about 25 degrees. Soft and out of focus behind it: a plain silver key ring and a phone lying screen-down in a plain dark case. At 0.2 s the bag drops a few centimetres and bounces on her lap as if she just sneezed; the keys slide and the liner hops, then settles back in focus. 1) There is almost no stock for this group. Every relevant clip on Pexels, Pixabay, Mixkit and Coverr comes from a small pool: office paper balls, labelled recycling bins (PAPER/PLASTIC/METAL/TRASH text), surgical masks, dark office mesh bins, and one tampon video. 2) Hero source = Pexels 7311931 (grey round pedal bin, white wall, wood floor, portrait, no branding). It gives a real lid open (3.55-4.00) and a real foot-off plus lid close (12.10-15.90), and it is the one bin that can tie V1-a S7, V1-b S11 and V1-c S4/S10 together. RESOLUTION CORRECTION: its 'uhd_2160_4096' link (also where Pexels' download button goes) actually delivers 1440x2732, not 4K, so the 60% crop is a 1.25x upscale (fine). Download it once and use the SAME crop box everywhere (x0.40-1.00, y0.30-0.86). HARD RULE: in that clip a hand lowers a tampon from the top of frame 0.0-8.5.
